# Pravdeep Kullar

> Forward Deployed Engineer and full-stack developer based in Ontario, Canada, with over 2 years of hands-on experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js, plus Python for ML. Works directly with client teams at Nx Growth Partners to scope AI and software problems into clear milestones and ship them, and was previously a full-stack developer at Mentera, a healthcare AI platform. Holds a graduate certificate in AI with Machine Learning from Humber Polytechnic (2026).

## Experience
- Forward Deployed Engineer, Nx Growth Partners (Feb 2026 to present). Custom software and AI development agency: AI agents, copilots, RAG and knowledge systems, custom web and mobile apps, and integrations into clients' existing stacks.
- Full-Stack Developer, Mentera (Jul 2024 to Dec 2025). Healthcare AI platform for private practices and medspas. Canvas side panel for Tera, the AI chat assistant; config-driven integration drawer covering 35 integrations; Next.js marketing site performance pass.
- Freelance Web Developer, Rosehill Design Build (2026). Next.js marketing site on Vercel; domain and DNS setup; client feedback rounds with the client's COO.
- Web Developer Intern, Rebelsnow (Jan 2024 to Jul 2024). Client e-commerce websites.

## Education and certifications

- Computer Programming Diploma, Humber Polytechnic (Sep 2023 to Aug 2025)

## Skills
- Front-end: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, JavaScript, Framer Motion, RTK Query, HTML/CSS, React Native (Expo)
- Back-end and APIs: Node.js, REST, WebSockets, Firebase (Auth, Firestore), FastAPI, Claude API (text and vision), OAuth
- AI / ML: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, logistic regression, MLP classifiers, XGBoost, AWS SageMaker
- Tools and platforms: Git, Vercel, Railway, LaunchDarkly, Jira, Xcode, Raspberry Pi, Claude Code, Cursor

## Selected work
- Forward deployed engineering (Nx Growth Partners): scoping client AI and software problems into milestones and coordinating delivery.
- [Tera (Mentera)](https://mentera.ai): Canvas side panel rendering streamed artifacts (markdown, code, HTML, SVG, Mermaid, React) with a sandboxed iframe renderer.
- Making sites fast and findable: Mentera marketing site performance pass and Rosehill hero-video delivery (ffmpeg, Cloudflare R2).
- [Rosehill Design Build](https://www.rosehilldesignbuild.com/): freelance Next.js site for an Ontario construction contractor.
- [Rising Sun Montessori School](https://risingsunmontessori.org/): school site with program-based navigation.
- [Rebelsnow](https://www.rebel-snow.com/): client e-commerce websites with catalog, cart, checkout, and payment.
- [FakeWordle](https://www.fakewordle.com): multiplayer Wordle-style game on Next.js 15, Firebase, a WebSocket server on Railway, and Claude Haiku word generation.
- [Schedule to calendar](https://schedule-to-calendar-two.vercel.app): Claude vision parses photographed timetables into Google Calendar and Outlook events.
- Cineplex ticket watcher: always-on Raspberry Pi 4 bot that monitors Cineplex ticket on-sale times and sends push notifications.
- Countdown widgets: iOS app on Expo SDK 54 and React Native 0.81 with SwiftUI WidgetKit Home Screen widgets.
- Health risk classifier: capstone comparing logistic regression against a small neural network. Not public yet.
- HuntigoX: capstone that checks job postings against fraud patterns. Not public yet.
